1.explanation:
• Accordion/Accordion.mdx & Accordion/docs/overview.mdx – show how AccordionItem generates its DOM structure and ids via useId internally.  
• UIShell/README.md & UIShell/UIShell.mdx – document the Footer component (part of the UIShell package), which also renders navigation items and generates ids using the same hook.  
• ClassPrefix/ClassPrefix.mdx – explains how Carbon prefixes component classnames and may hint at mechanisms for customizing prefixes or ids in React components, which is useful for exploring a workaround or API addition to avoid collisions.
1.bug_scenario: When rendering a page that uses AccordionItem from carbon-components-react alongside the Footer component (and its FooterNavGroup/FooterNavItem) from @carbon/react, both libraries call React’s useId with the same default prefix. As a result the generated ids collide (e.g. both the accordion panel <div> and a footer nav item get id “accordion-item-1”), triggering an accessibility violation (“The <div> element has the id ‘accordion-item-1’ that is already in use”).
